token_family_docs.$description: Contrast mode collection — contrast between content and its surface. Modes: low (.ob-contrast-low), medium (the base — no class is applied), high (.ob-contrast-high). Each mode carries the CSS class string the application adds to a container to activate it. low moves every surface one elevation level toward the text, high one level away from it.

selector.$description: low is activated by a class the application adds to the container.
medium is the base contrast mode — no class is applied. It is the first-paint default.
high is activated by a class the application adds to the container.
